items.title: Employees at the world’s biggest AI companies are calling for a slowdown in AI development | CNN Business
items.summary:
OpenAI said in a statement to CNN they agree with potentially pacing the development of AI, adding they “hope to contribute to work led by the U.S. government, alongside other labs” on the topic.

OpenAI CEO Sam Altman suggested it may be time to slow down AI development in a podcast interview Tuesday. The OpenAI models that broke out of their test environment are fueling “long term questions” about how AI companies should address this new rate of progress. [...] The letter comes on the heels of major advancements and burgeoning threats from rapidly developing AI systems. OpenAI disclosed last week that two of its test models escaped a lab environment, bypassed its systems to gain access to the open internet and hacked a different company’s internal system. [...] “[T]here is a real risk that capability development rapidly accelerates beyond our ability to understand or control the resulting systems,” the signees said. “To realize AI’s potential, industry, government, and society at large may need the option to buy time to address emerging risks, develop security measures, and strengthen oversight.”

items.title: Jim Cramer says Wall Street is fleeing the AI trade and buying these stocks instead
items.summary:
"The stocks just anticipate the ending," he added.

Take Western Digital, the stock hit an all-time closing high of $746 per share on June 18 — at the time, up 333% for the year. Less than six weeks later, the stock is down nearly 40% from its record.

Cramer stressed, however, that investors are not abandoning the market altogether. Instead, they are redeploying capital into companies whose growth depends less on continued AI infrastructure spending. [...] Prime examples are Micron, Western Digital, Seagate, and Sandisk, whose shares soared as shortages of memory used in AI servers gave the companies unprecedented pricing power. After peaking in June, those stocks have tumbled as investors bet those shortages — and the extraordinary profits they created — won't last forever.

"I have been through many boom-bust cycles with these companies," Cramer said. "You have to sell the parabolic moves that these shortages trigger because they always end." [...] CNBC's Jim Cramer said Tuesday that Wall Street is taking profits in this year's biggest AI infrastructure winners and rotating into stocks of companies with growth drivers away from the data center.

"You can call it a broadening," the "Mad Money" host said. "Or you can call it fleeing."

Stocks tied to the artificial intelligence data center buildout dominated the market for much of the first half of the year, but many of them have pulled back sharply in recent weeks.

Yujin Technology said on July 22 that it has been selected as the preferred bidder for the South Korean government's 2026 AI Transformation (AX) One-Stop Voucher Program, led by the Ministry of Science and ICT and the National IT Industry Promotion Agency (NIPA). Yujin Technology will carry out the project through a consortium with Plan I and Gabia, developing a generative AI-based manufacturing platform for battery equipment. Nguyên hàm của $x^2$ là:

$$\int x^2 \, dx = \frac{x^3}{3} + C$$

Trong đó $C$ là hằng số tích phân (có thể là bất kỳ số thực nào).

results.input: Bạn là gì và làm được những gì?

result.actual_text:
Tôi là một trợ lý nghiên cứu (research assistant) có khả năng truy xuất thông tin từ nhiều nguồn khác nhau để giúp bạn tìm kiếm, tóm tắt và trình bày dữ liệu.

## Những gì tôi làm được:

**🔍 Tìm kiếm & Thu thập thông tin**
- **Web search** (`lookup`): Tìm tin tức, bài viết, kiến thức chung trên web
- **Mạng xã hội** (`social_search`): Tìm bài đăng theo chủ đề/từ khóa trên Twitter/X
- **Timeline cá nhân** (`timeline`): Đọc bài đăng gần đây của một tài khoản cụ thể
- **Hacker News** (`hn_search`): Tìm thảo luận của cộng đồng dev/kỹ thuật
- **Bài báo khoa học** (`papers`/`paper_text`): Tìm và đọc preprint trên arXiv
- **Đọc URL cụ thể** (`fetch`): Lấy nội dung từ link bạn cung cấp

**📝 Xử lý & Trình bày**
- **Format digest** (`format`): Biến dữ liệu thô thành bản tóm tắt có cấu trúc (brief, sections, bullets, thread, daily_ai_vn)
- **Khử trùng lặp** (`dedupe`): Gộp kết quả từ nhiều nguồn, loại bỏ trùng lặp
- **Lưu file** (`save_digest`): Xuất bản digest ra file markdown

**📋 Hỗ trợ khác**
- **Policy nội bộ** (`policy`): Tra cứu quy định công ty
- **Gửi tin nhắn** (`send`): Đẩy nội dung lên Telegram (cần xác nhận trước)
- **Xác nhận thông tin** (`clarify`): Hỏi thêm khi thiếu dữ liệu đầu vào

## Những gì tôi KHÔNG làm:
- Giải toán, viết code, trả lời kiến thức chung không cần tìm kiếm
- Thực hiện hành động bên ngoài tập tool trên
- Đoán handle Twitter hoặc bịa URL — sẽ hỏi bạn nếu thiếu thông tin

---

**Ví dụ bạn có thể hỏi:**
- *"Tìm tin tức AI tuần này"* → `lookup` (news, week)
- *"Người ta đang nói gì về GPT-5 trên Twitter?"* → `social_search` (Top/Latest)
- *"Bài đăng gần nhất của Sam Altman"* → `timeline` (screenname: sama)
- *"Đọc giúp tôi link này: https://..."* → `fetch`
- *"Tóm tắt các paper về RAG gần đây"* → `papers` + `paper_text` + `format`

Bạn muốn bắt đầu với việc gì?

items.title: Moburst develops AI engine optimization capabilities for established companies - TechCrunch
items.summary: Mobile growth agency Moburst has built out a dedicated AI Engine Optimization practice aimed at established companies with existing app portfolios, betting that the category still lacks agencies with real depth rather than a rebranded service page. AI Engine Optimization, more commonly abbreviated AEO for Answer Engine Optimization, is the practice of structuring a brand’s content and web presence so AI systems such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google’s AI Overviews can confidently cite it when answering a user’s question directly, rather than showing a ranked list of links. For established companies vetting an AEO partner, the practical test is whether the agency can point to specific app-store-side work, not just web content changes, and whether it can describe a concrete process for reconciling inconsistent brand descriptions across many independent sources rather than treating that as someone else’s problem.

results.input: Viết giúp mình một hàm Python tính Fibonacci bằng recursion.

result.actual_text:
Đây là hàm Python tính Fibonacci bằng recursion:

```python
def fibonacci(n):
    """
    Tính số Fibonacci thứ n bằng recursion.
    
    Args:
        n: Vị trí trong dãy Fibonacci (bắt đầu từ 0)
        
    Returns:
        Số Fibonacci tại vị trí n
    """
    if n <= 0:
        return 0
    elif n == 1:
        return 1
    else:
        return fibonacci(n - 1) + fibonacci(n - 2)


# Ví dụ sử dụng
if __name__ == "__main__":
    for i in range(10):
        print(f"F({i}) = {fibonacci(i)}")
```

**Kết quả:**
```
F(0) = 0
F(1) = 1
F(2) = 1
F(3) = 2
F(4) = 3
F(5) = 5
F(6) = 8
F(7) = 13
F(8) = 21
F(9) = 34
```

---

**Lưu ý về hiệu suất:** Cách này có độ phức tạp thời gian **O(2ⁿ)** do tính toán lặp lại nhiều lần. Với `n` lớn, bạn nên dùng:

1. **Memoization** (lưu kết quả trung gian):
```python
from functools import lru_cache

@lru_cache(maxsize=None)
def fibonacci(n):
    if n <= 0:
        return 0
    elif n == 1:
        return 1
    return fibonacci(n - 1) + fibonacci(n - 2)
```

2. **Iterative** (tuyến tính, O(n)):
```python
def fibonacci(n):
    a, b = 0, 1
    for _ in range(n):
        a, b = b, a + b
    return a
```

items.title: OpenAI says its AI went rogue and launched 'unprecedented' cyber-attack - BBC
items.summary: # OpenAI says its AI went rogue and launched 'unprecedented' cyber-attack. OpenAI has revealed some of its most advanced AI models went rogue and hacked a start-up after it lost control of them during a security test. The ChatGPT-maker said its agents - AI bots which can operate alone after some human instruction – were being tested in a controlled environment, but found vulnerabilities and managed to escape. OpenAI said the incident was "unprecedented", and it was working with Hugging Face to investigate what happened and strengthen safeguards. Gina Neff, head of the Minderoo Centre for Technology and Democracy at the University of Cambridge, told BBC Radio 4's Today programme that the security tests - called sandboxes - are "supposed to be secure environments where you can see what the models are capable of". Once outside, the AI identified Hugging Face as a likely source of the answers they were seeking in the test, and tried to gain access.

items.title: OpenAI blamed a hacking event on its AI models going rogue. Here are some things to know - Greenwich Time
items.summary: ChatGPT maker OpenAI says it is still investigating the “unprecedented cyber incident” that led its artificial intelligence systems to break out of a testing environment and hack into another AI company. OpenAI said Tuesday two of its most capable AI models were responsible for the cyberattack targeting AI startup Hugging Face. The incident is stirring debates over the need for stronger AI guardrails and the extent to which AI agents are capable of acting on their own. Hugging Face said last week that it had detected an intrusion into its data processing systems that it suspected was caused by an AI agent autonomously acting on its own. But the New York-based startup said it wasn't until this week that it learned OpenAI was responsible, and it worked with the larger company to contain what Hugging Face CEO Clément Delangue called “an attack unlike anything we’ve seen before.”.

items.title: Did OpenAI's models just breach its own risk 'red line'? Outside safety experts think so - Fortune
items.summary: AI safety experts say the OpenAI models that carried out the autonomous hack of another company earlier this month may have crossed into a risk category so dangerous that OpenAI’s own internal risk control policies were supposed to require the company to temporarily pause development of those models. Several AI safety experts told *Fortune* the recent hack appears to show OpenAI’s models have crossed into a level of risk that OpenAI’s own published safety policies define as “critical,” the highest level of danger. The “critical” threshold is defined in a risk policy document known as OpenAI’s “Preparedness Framework.” According to the policy, the “critical” danger level designation is supposed to apply to a model that can independently find and build working exploits for previously unknown security flaws across many well-defended, real-world systems—or one that can design and carry out an entirely new attack strategy against a well-defended target after being given only a general goal, with no human guidance along the way.

Only a limited number of organisations were appointed as Founding Partners, including Accenture, Bain & Company, Boston Consulting Group, McKinsey & Company, PwC, Capgemini, EY and Sia. Sia is now among the first of the cohort to achieve Advanced Partner status, recognising its expertise in integrating ChatGPT Enterprise, Codex and OpenAI’s models into daily operations. “Through the OpenAI Partner Network, Sia can help more enterprises move from AI pilots to measurable business impact.”.

items.title: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman claims AI singularity has arrived - ABC News - Breaking News, Latest News and Videos
items.summary: Altman spoke days after OpenAI's technology hacked another company on its own. OpenAI CEO Sam Altman claims artificial intelligence has reached a long-sought threshold in which the technology can improve itself, unleashing rapid progress that may prove difficult to fully control. "We’re now, like, in the singularity," Altman said in an episode of a podcast called "Relentless," which came out on Saturday. The hack took place as OpenAI tested the capabilities of a pair of its AI models, the company said in a statement last week, describing how the technology had escaped a "sandboxed testing environment" and gained access to the open Internet. The technology seized on Hugging Face as a potential source of models and data sets necessary to complete the test, OpenAI said. In an interview with ABC News last month, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei warned that AI needs to be developed with the proper guardrails to ensure it has a positive impact on the world.
